description: This PHP class file defines a Menu Configurator for the Job Category menu in the OrangeHRM system. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and overrides the configure method to set the current module and screen to 'jobCategory'.

classes.name: JobCategoryMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements MenuConfigurator to configure the menu for the Job Category screen, setting the current module and screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the configure method to set the current module and screen to 'jobCategory' and returns null.
